recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5209 unless Patient Administration later reopens whether EpisodeOfCare should continue to hold a direct incoming referral reference.
issue_request: FHIR-5209 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Jan 2015 ballot issue asking whether referralRequest should remain linked directly to EpisodeOfCare or go through Encounter; the final resolution directed EpisodeOfCare and Encounter to point to the referral, with discussion of incomingReferralRequest/fulfilsReferral naming and 0..* cardinality.
initial_application: The explicit FHIR-5209 application was git commit 27302910ae49c6d1fd5544682e5f48f9e365b347, which added Encounter.incomingReferralRequest as 0..* Reference(ReferralRequest) plus an incomingReferral search parameter. The EpisodeOfCare side already existed and was refined by the closely related March 2015 EpisodeOfCare reconciliation commit f659c3fbc16870414aac80f798d75afcb5480bf8, which made EpisodeOfCare.referralRequest repeatable and defined it as incoming referrals fulfilled by the EpisodeOfCare.
additional_context: Encounter and EpisodeOfCare are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Later source history renamed Encounter.incomingReferral to Encounter.basedOn and folded ReferralRequest into ServiceRequest; source/fhir.ini records both migrations. The related FHIR-5210 referral-direction issue is already audited on the combined branch and cites FHIR-5209 as the same change family. Zulip and Confluence searches found no direct FHIR-5209 discussion or minutes record that conflicts with the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current Encounter.basedOn is 0..* with an incomingReferral alias and includes ServiceRequest among its targets, while current EpisodeOfCare.referralRequest is 0..* Reference(ServiceRequest) and is defined as incoming referrals fulfilled by the EpisodeOfCare.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-5210 explicitly refers to FHIR-5209 for inbound versus outbound referral handling and is already represented on the combined branch by audit commit 6a4bfe70d050a8b89dd62397a7cd9fb14bfd4be1.
The later change renamed Encounter.incomingReferral to Encounter.basedOn and broadened it to workflow request resources, preserving the FHIR-5209 Encounter semantics under current naming.
